errors.text_span: като етикетите са разположени през една година
errors.evidence: The phrase "през една година" translates to "every other year". However, the x-axis has a label for every single year from 2012 to 2019, not every other year.
The line ends at a value of approximately 21,500 in 2019, not 22,000. This is a noticeable overestimation.
